Falcons lose the semi-final 1-2 to BETBOOM and play for third place.
featured.upshot_note: Aurora are the underdog here at 42.9% by the ratings model, which is above the 35% floor, and they are rested in one sense - they lost 0-2 to FURIA while Falcons went the distance against BETBOOM and played a third map. There is no HotSpawn crowd split for this match, because HotSpawn does not list it, so there is no leaderboard edge to measure and the pick stays on the more likely side: Falcons.
featured.verified_by: HLTV event matches page and the match page itself read 2026-10-17; bo3.gg lists the same pairing, kickoff and Bo3 on its event page. The HLTV page rendered 07:30 in the fetch server's UTC-4 display and its live countdown agreed with 11:30 UTC.
featured.basis_detail: No external book price at this capture. Valve's own global regional standings (2026-10-05) rate Aurora 1716 and Falcons 1843. Valve's published rating curve, with the slope the repository fits to 60 observed bookmaker lines (k=0.4308), gives 42.4%; Valve's raw slope would give 32.9%. This is a ratings model, not a bookmaker price.

notes: FURIA beat Aurora 2-0 in the semi-final and are through to defend their 2025 title.
BETBOOM beat Falcons 2-1 in the semi-final and are through to the final.
featured.upshot_note: BETBOOM at 37.2% is a real shot at an upset, and the format helps them: a Bo5 gives them five maps, their only loss in this event was 0-2 to FURIA in the group stage, and they have already beaten Falcons 2-1 in a semi-final. But the ratings model still has FURIA 233 points ahead (1829 v 1596), FURIA are the higher-ranked side (#4 v #14) and in form (4/5, straight sets against Aurora in the semi-final), and there is no HotSpawn crowd split or book price for this match to fade. So the pick is FURIA and BETBOOM is published as the upset shot at 37.2% rather than taken.

flags.title: The bo3.gg 'rating' field is a tournament-level metric and is not used as a win probability
flags.detail: Every match of the same bo3.gg tournament carries the same 'rating' value (for example 0.0416 for the whole of tournament 6050), so it cannot be a per-match win probability. Only bo3.gg's bookmaker coefficients inside 'bet_updates' are used, and only when both sides carry one. This is recorded because the field is easy to mistake for a model probability.

flags.title: HotSpawn's own crowd percentages are never a probability input
flags.detail: HotSpawn's 'picked %' is carried on every row as leaderboard context only, labelled as such, and is excluded from every probability. The published probability comes from external bookmaker prices, or from the official Valve ratings model when no book prices the match.

flags.title: Valve's official ratings snapshot used is 2026-10-05
flags.detail: Valve's counter-strike_regional_standings repository publishes a dated global standings file; the newest one in the repository is live/2026/standings_global_2026_10_05.md. Ratings are therefore twelve days old at the time of this page, inside the fourteen-day freshness rule the canonical board already applies, but they are not a live feed.
